title_zh: 央行11月用买断式逆回购从市场净收回3000亿元
title_en: In November the central bank took a net 300 billion yuan back from the market through outright reverse repos

paragraphs.zh: 中国人民银行11月16日进行了一次买断式逆回购操作，金额是2000亿元，期限是6个月。这个月一共有3000亿元6个月期的这种操作到期，所以这个期限净收回了1000亿元。
paragraphs.en: On November 16, the People's Bank of China carried out an outright reverse repo operation of 200 billion yuan with a term of 6 months. A total of 300 billion yuan of this kind of 6-month operation matures this month, so for this term a net 100 billion yuan was taken back.

paragraphs.zh: 11月5日，央行还做了一次3个月期的买断式逆回购，金额为3000亿元。因为本月到期的3个月期操作有5000亿元，这次净收回了2000亿元。
paragraphs.en: On November 5, the central bank also did a 3-month outright reverse repo of 300 billion yuan. Because the 3-month operations maturing this month add up to 500 billion yuan, this time a net 200 billion yuan was taken back.

paragraphs.zh: 把两个期限加起来，央行11月通过买断式逆回购从市场净收回3000亿元。10月的情况正好相反，央行通过这个工具净投放了4000亿元。
paragraphs.en: Adding the two terms together, in November the central bank took a net 300 billion yuan back from the market through outright reverse repos. October was just the opposite: the central bank put a net 400 billion yuan into the market with this tool.

paragraphs.zh: 逆回购是央行向银行提供资金的一种常用方法：央行先买进银行的债券，把钱借给银行，到期后银行再把债券买回去。另外，从11月2日起，央行每个工作日都进行隔夜逆回购操作，利率为1.25%。
paragraphs.en: A reverse repo is a common way for the central bank to provide funds to banks: the central bank first buys bonds from banks, lending them money, and when the term ends the banks buy the bonds back. In addition, since November 2, the central bank has carried out overnight reverse repo operations every working day, at an interest rate of 1.25%.

vocab.en: central bank (short for 中央银行)
outright reverse repo (central bank liquidity tool)
People's Bank of China (PBOC), China's central bank
to put in (money into the market); to release

glossary.py: bǎi fēn zhī yī diǎn èr wǔ

featured.note: Central bank tool to put short-term money into banks. Common: 开展逆回购操作 (carry out a reverse repo), 7天期逆回购 (7-day reverse repo), 逆回购利率 (reverse repo rate).

examples.zh: 央行今天开展了5000亿元7天期逆回购操作。
examples.py: Yāngháng jīntiān kāizhǎn le wǔqiān yì yuán qī tiān qī nìhuígòu cāozuò.
examples.en: The central bank carried out a 500 billion yuan 7-day reverse repo operation today.

examples.zh: 逆回购到期以后，银行要把钱还给央行。
examples.py: Nìhuígòu dàoqī yǐhòu, yínháng yào bǎ qián huán gěi yāngháng.
examples.en: After a reverse repo matures, the banks must pay the money back to the central bank.

examples.zh: 我朋友说，月底在手机上买国债逆回购，可以多赚一点利息。
examples.py: Wǒ péngyou shuō, yuèdǐ zài shǒujī shàng mǎi guózhài nìhuígòu, kěyǐ duō zhuàn yìdiǎn lìxī.
examples.en: My friend says that buying government bond reverse repos on your phone at the end of the month can earn a bit more interest.

featured.note: Very common in finance news. Collocations: 下调利率 / 上调利率 (cut / raise rates), 贷款利率 (loan rate), 存款利率 (deposit rate), 利率为… (the rate is …).

examples.zh: 央行宣布下调政策利率0.1个百分点。
examples.py: Yāngháng xuānbù xiàtiáo zhèngcè lìlǜ líng diǎn yī gè bǎifēndiǎn.
examples.en: The central bank announced a 0.1 percentage point cut to its policy rate.

examples.zh: 现在银行的存款利率越来越低了。
examples.py: Xiànzài yínháng de cúnkuǎn lìlǜ yuè lái yuè dī le.
examples.en: Bank deposit rates are getting lower and lower now.

examples.zh: 买房以前，我比较了三家银行的房贷利率。
examples.py: Mǎi fáng yǐqián, wǒ bǐjiào le sān jiā yínháng de fángdài lìlǜ.
examples.en: Before buying a home, I compared the mortgage rates of three banks.
